note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are passed directly into libmagic for parsing.
The input buffer and its length are wrapped into the internal buffer pipeline.
Text classification is computed from the attacker-controlled buffer length and contents.
The implementation assumes the input length is sufficient for the ASCII/encoding probes; the safety obligation is that the probe must not read past the provided buffer end.
The parser dereferences and advances through the input byte-by-byte; the reported bug is a 1-byte heap-buffer-overflow read when this walk reaches one byte past the allocated buffer.
